design.name: 冰甲旋龟
design.brief: The xuangui (旋龟) of the Shan Hai Jing, a black turtle with a bird's head and a viper's tail, frozen into a tank: a huge low turtle about 3.2 m long with a hooked eagle-like beak head, thick elephant-like legs with three blunt claws each, and a tall domed shell of translucent glacier-blue ice over dark verdigris-bronze scutes, the shell rim ringed with short heavy ice spikes. Its long viper tail ends in a snake head whose eyes and mouth glow cyan-violet (weak spot, behind it). The shell top has a round vent hole that glows when it overheats from spinning. Heavy, stubborn, armoured.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps. Its defence is its own shell: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a big tortoise (quadruped), the shell level, the four thick legs straight under the shell and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them, belly clear of the ground; the eagle-beaked head extended forward and level on its neck, beak closed; the long viper tail extending straight backwards and slightly upward behind the shell (not curled), its snake-head tip facing backwards with the eyes painted opaque cyan-violet; the shell vent on top closed and dark; no glow halo, no flames, no particles
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with three separate blunt claws; the head, the whole tail and every shell spike fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
